transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what’s been bothering you or what brings you in today?

I guess I’m here because I’ve been really hard on myself lately. I keep thinking I’m not actually senior material at work, like I somehow fooled people into thinking I can handle more than I really can. It’s been bothering me enough that I thought I should talk to someone.
Have you been feeling like you’re not good enough or felt guilty about things you’ve done or didn’t do at work or in other areas of your life?

Yeah, I have. Mostly at work. I keep beating myself up, like maybe I’m not really senior-level material and I somehow convinced everyone I could handle more than I actually can. It makes me feel pretty guilty and like I’m not good enough.
Have you been feeling this way every day, or does it come and go?

It comes and goes, but it’s been on my mind a lot lately. I’ll start thinking I’m not really cut out for the senior role, like I somehow fooled people into trusting me with more than I can actually handle. It’s not every single minute, but it keeps coming back.
Have you noticed yourself feeling down or losing interest in things you usually enjoy, even outside of work?

Yeah, a bit. I usually look forward to things like grilling on the weekend, going fishing, or just putting on a record at home. Lately I just kind of leave that stuff sitting there and don’t really care enough to do it.
Have you been feeling down or having a low mood most of the day, nearly every day, not just when you're thinking about work?

Yeah… most days lately it’s been there. Not just when I’m thinking about work. It’s like this heavy, low feeling, and I’m kind of just getting through the day at work and at home with everything feeling dulled down.
Have you been feeling fatigued or like you don’t have much energy lately, even when you’re not thinking about work?
Yeah, I have. By the time I get home from the office, I feel pretty wiped out. Even little things like checking the mail or loading the dishwasher feel like they take more effort than they should.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight lately, like eating a lot less or more than usual?

Yeah, my appetite’s been off. I’ll kind of just grab a few bites here and there, or skip supper without really meaning to. My belt’s been feeling a little looser too, and I’m not trying to lose weight.
Have you been feeling worthless or guilty, like you’re a failure or have let people down, nearly every day?

Yeah… I do. I keep beating myself up about work, like maybe I’m not really senior material and I somehow fooled everyone into thinking I can handle more than I actually can. It’s been hard to shake that feeling.
Have you noticed yourself moving more slowly than usual, or feeling restless and unable to sit still lately?

Not really moving slow, no. If anything, I’ve had times where I kind of ramp up and start doing more than I need to. I took on extra monitoring reports at work and started messaging clients and coworkers with ideas before anyone even asked, like I was trying to prove I could run the whole thing myself.
Have you found that you no longer take pleasure in almost anything, including things you used to really enjoy, like grilling, fishing, or listening to records?

Yeah, I’d say that’s been happening. I usually look forward to grilling on the weekend, or going fishing, or just putting on a record, but lately I just… don’t bother. The stuff’s just sitting there, and I don’t really feel like I care much.
Have you had any previous episodes where you felt down, lost interest in things, or had low energy that lasted for at least two weeks?

Yeah… looking back, those low periods have been going on off and on for maybe eleven months now. Not nonstop every single day, but they hang around long enough that it feels like it’s been a real pattern.
Between these low periods you've been having, have there been times when you felt back to normal or significantly better for at least a couple of months?

Not really for a couple months, no. Looking back, these low, guilty stretches have been coming and going for about eleven months, so I don’t feel like I’ve had a long solid break where I was just back to normal.

Looking back over the past eleven months, have there been any periods lasting at least two weeks where your mood was down and you lost interest in things almost every day, along with other symptoms like low energy or changes in appetite?

Yeah… I think so. Looking back, those low, guilty stretches have been hanging around off and on for about eleven months. They weren’t just a bad day here and there—it felt like they’d settle in for a while.

The severity is considered severe based on the presence of marked functional impairment, loss of interest in almost all activities, significant guilt, and changes in appetite and energy.
